title: When clouds release rain
description: A cloud magnification shows small liquid droplets colliding and coalescing. Larger drops fall under gravity across the watershed.

style.reference: The living watershed · illustrated scientific atlas
style.artDirection: Semi-realistic layered vector landscape. Atmospheric mountain facets, sculpted foliage, restrained water highlights and precise scientific magnifications. Colour denotes substance; invisible vapour appears only as explicitly schematic molecules.

stages.title: Inside a cloud
stages.description: Clouds contain many tiny suspended droplets. This magnified window shows liquid drops, not vapour.

stages.title: Collisions make larger drops
stages.description: Small droplets meet and combine. Some grow large enough to fall more readily through the surrounding air.

stages.title: Rain returns water
stages.description: Gravity pulls the larger drops towards the mountains, forest, river and lake. Motion accelerates downward; drops are shown round, not tear-shaped.
